args.sql:
-- Update firmware for Series_892 robots without application assigned
UPDATE robot_details 
SET fwversionval = '3.4.0'
WHERE modelseriesval = 'Series_892' 
  AND botdetreg IN (
    SELECT rd.botdetreg 
    FROM robot_details rd
    JOIN robot_record rr ON rd.botdetreg = rr.botcode
    LEFT JOIN operation o ON rr.recreg = o.operrecref
    WHERE rd.modelseriesval = 'Series_892' 
      AND (o.apptypeval IS NULL OR o.apptypeval = 'None')
  );

-- Set application type to 'Standby' for Series_892 robots without application assigned
UPDATE operation 
SET apptypeval = 'Standby'
WHERE operrecref IN (
    SELECT rr.botcode 
    FROM robot_details rd
    JOIN robot_record rr ON rd.botdetreg = rr.botcode
    LEFT JOIN operation o ON rr.recreg = o.operrecref
    WHERE rd.modelseriesval = 'Series_892' 
      AND (o.apptypeval IS NULL OR o.apptypeval = 'None')
);
